API.feed: nonempty bytes <= configured feed cap; helper guards UTF8/DTD/namespaces/raw lexical limits; semantic layer finite stack/scalars/attrs/schema controls.
API.revision_callback: At closing each direct page/revision; fields revision_ID,page_ordinal,revision_ordinal,page_ID,span,attributes,fields,contributor,contributor_attributes,contents,sibling_SHA1,holds,unknown_count,unknown_examples,unknown_descriptor_SHA256. No accumulated page revisions list.
API.page_callback: At original raw page span/hash emission after closing direct page. Fields page_ordinal,page_ID,title,namespace,redirect,revision_count,main_text,model,format,holds,unknown_count,unknown_examples,unknown_descriptor_SHA256,raw_XML,no_admission_or_English_claim.
API.finish: Actual XML root close/Expat finalization required. Returns counts/bounded root/siteinfo diagnostics and resource maxima, no global identity/English/article/usable claim.
API.finish_prefix: Pinned v3 helper terminal-flushes Expat deferred token first, then semantic checks root-only stack/no active page/revision/pending emission. Root remains open, no bytes invented; caller must separately prove exact BZ2/indexgroup boundary.

identities.integers: Direct page/revision IDs positive signed SQLite int64; namespace signed int64 incl0; ASCII decimal only, canonical integer interpretation, leading zeros permitted. Missing/duplicate direct identity fields, child-markup identity/title, overflow or invalid direct IDs are explicit terminal failures; never NULL/0 coercion.
identities.duplicate_revision_IDs: All valid occurrence callbacks preserved even same page/crosspage/repeated canonical numeric ID. No global revision/page ID set or uniqueness assertion; caller reconciles every page ordinal/ID/exacttitle to complete frozen index.
identities.parent_contributor: Contributor ID never used as page/revision ID; username/id/ip raw scalar descriptors and container deletion attrs retained. No author-history completeness or rights clearance inferred.

content.scope: Metadata only: no rendered wikitext/prose extraction or tokenizer. Huge ordinary text streamed decoded-UTF8 SHA256/SHA1/byte count; no whole page raw/text string.
content.main_text: Unique one-revision and structurally single legacy/main slot descriptor only; otherwise null. A populated descriptor does NOT mean all holds passed.
content.slots: All slots within cap retained per revision until its prompt callback. Auxiliary/missing/mixed/multiplemain/legacy+slot ambiguity explicit holds. Model and format preserved separately; wikitext/applicationjson not supported wiki content.
content.hashes: Text@bytes and base36 text@sha1 separately MATCH/MISMATCH/INVALID/MISSING; optional content/slot sha1 and revision sibling sha1 compared only against unambiguous supported nondeleted text, otherwise explicit unverified/missing/deleted. Hash comparison is XML-decoded UTF8, whereas raw_XML.SHA256 binds original source including entity/CDATA spelling.
content.raw_spans: Absolute original decoded XML byte offsets end-exclusive, original page rawSHA from root helper. Revision/field/slot spans use exact opening/closing token shape incl selfclosing. Revision rawSHA not separately computed; parent raw page hash + revisionordinal/span permits later source recovery.

bounds.raw_helper: Default feed65536/token1048576/decoded256GB/page25792234; explicit caller finite overrides for eventual calibration/full profile. Not acquisition/run authority.
bounds.memory: No tree, page list, ID sets or accumulated revision list. Stack<=depth; scalar text retained<=65536 per ordinary metadata leaf, cleared with oversize hold; original text never retained. Namespace map<=512, bounded contents<=16 per revision, unknown descriptors<=16 with exact totalcount+ordered digest+original source span backing. Caller must consume/release callbacks; downstream retaining all rows is outside this core guarantee.
bounds.oversized_scalar: Unknown nonidentity scalar streamed hash/count and explicit OVERSIZED_SCALAR_METADATA with valueNULL (no silent truncation). Direct identity/title unrepresentable stops. Ordinary text not subject to metadata scalar cap.
bounds.per_page_revisions: At revision10001 default explicit terminal failure, no silent ignored excess. Overall30M revision and SQL/output caps belong external producer/sink.
bounds.unknown_schema: Unknown children/attributes, scalar childmarkup and nonwhitespace container characterdata explicit holds, exact bounded descriptors/count/hash where applicable. Header/root holds discovered late apply entire producer frame, including prior emitted provisional pages; caller must not infer per-page eligibility before global completion.

sink_handoff.callbacks_provisional: Emit revision before page; deferred foreign keys permitted in parent-owned group transaction. All callbacks and page rawhash/identity/index correspondence must reconcile before whole group atomic commit; callback/parser failure means unfinished group not committed.
sink_handoff.no_extra_DB_schema: Root owns measured compact SQL page/group/revision tables and enum/flag codec; this module adds no SQL/indices/producer. Rich callback diagnostics are NOT instructions to persist full JSON/title/author strings per page. Use bounded exception budget and raw page locator; retain holds/protected priority.
sink_handoff.exact_title: Ephemeral unnormalized Unicode title supplied for external expected-index title equality; no separate title storage/index proposed.
sink_handoff.format_nulls: Model/format content absent/ambiguous staysNone. Missing hash/nativebytes comparison is explicit status, never numeric0/falsematch.
sink_handoff.group_spans: raw_XML.start/end absolute decoded positions; external producer converts start to containinggroup-relative offset only after group identity/bounds proof.
sink_handoff.namespace_range: Core namespace signedint64 deliberately exceeds measured sink signedint32. Sink must refuse values outside signedint32 before insert/atomic group commit; no modulo/truncation/zero coercion. This does not add a new SQL schema field.

header.root: Both full and prefix summaries retain exact root expanded name, original xmlns prefix/URI declarations, raw opening-token span and ordinary attributes incl expanded xsi:schemaLocation. Original XML not rewritten.
header.siteinfo: Exact base scalar descriptor retained alongside bounded namespace metadata. Default require_enwiki_base=True validates nonempty no-whitespace/control https://en.wikipedia.org exactnetloc and nofragment; invalid/missing yields explicit SITEINFO_BASE_UNSUPPORTED_OR_MISSING frame/page hold. Fixture optout explicitly reports NOT_REQUIRED_BY_FIXTURE_CONFIGURATION and cannot authorize enwiki producer COMPLETE.
header.producer_completion_requirement: Caller must require VERIFIED_HTTPS_ENWIKI_BASE plus no unresolved source/header schema holds before COMPLETE/eligible-frame claim; finish()/finish_prefix() receipts are parsing results, not producer publication authority.

version_note: Frozen v1 preserved; v2 narrow header/base fidelity addition requested by parent. No source operation or limits widened.
